Author: ViewInFFXIV
Name: ViewInFFXIV
Punchline: Watch w2g together on a wall in your house.
Description: Runs a w2g (Watch2Gether) room in its own hidden Brave browser and puts the video on a 16:9 screen in your house at 1080p. Create or join rooms from in game, with play/pause/seek and English subtitles. Requires Windows 10/11 and the Brave browser (brave.com). Open with /viewin.
